◆ Pure Fiction ◆
Pure Fiction contains a series of challenging stages. In this mode, you need to challenge the stages and earn the required number of points to pass the challenge and get splendid rewards. In addition, you will get bonus rewards by achieving specific targets. The difficulty and rewards of Pure Fiction stages are not affected by your Equilibrium Level.

Stages and rewards in Pure Fiction are regularly updated.

You will be cut off from the outside world when entering the Pure Fiction, with the following actions temporarily disabled:
● Changing team setup
● Changing, leveling up, or ascending Light Cones and Relics
● Upgrading or ascending characters
● Using Consumables in your Inventory

In Pure Fiction, when ally characters defeat enemy targets, they regenerate only <unbreak>50%</unbreak> of the Energy that they would normally do in regular battles.

◆ Whimsicality ◆
Each Pure Fiction phase has its unique rules, resulting in various stage effects. The effects only take effect in battle during its corresponding phase.

◆ Cacophony ◆
Various buffs are provided at the beginning of each Pure Fiction event.
You can select one of the buffs for each team before challenging any stage in the Pure Fiction.

◆ Points ◆
In this mode, enemies will appear for a limited number of Cycles. Dealing damage and defeating enemies earn you points.
Each stage contains two battles, namely Node 1 and Node 2. Your final points are the total points earned in both battles, and your highest points will be updated based on the points earned in the current challenge.

◆ Quick Unlock ◆
All stages in Pure Fiction that have been cleared with a 3-star rating are recorded. When a new event starts, all the cleared stages and their prerequisite stages will be immediately unlocked.
After Quick Unlock takes effect, you can directly challenge the last recorded stage that you passed with 3-stars. Once you have passed that stage with a 3-star rating, all the previous stages will be immediately cleared with a 3-star rating, and all rewards from those stages will be delivered to you.
Currently, only the first 3 stages can be quickly unlocked in this way.

◆ Starward Mode ◆ 
Clear Stage 3 of Pure Fiction to automatically unlock Starward Mode, and Stage 4 of Starward Mode will be unlocked.
● Clearing Stage 4 of Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes, and 3-star challenge records are shared with Stage 4 of the Regular Mode.
● Clear Stage 4 of Starward Mode and obtain <unbreak>99,000</unbreak> points to obtain the Prismatic Star and additional new rewards.
● Accumulate <unbreak>12</unbreak> stars and the Prismatic Star to also obtain this period's Pure Fiction Limited-Time Clearance Medal.
● You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 4 of the regular Pure Fiction and obtain the original rewards.
